children: Construction costs in Saudi Arabia rose in August 2026 compared to the same month last year, driven by higher labour charges and an increase in energy prices, according to the General Authority of Statistics.

The construction cost index (CCI) in the residential sector climbed 2.1 percent year-on-year (YoY), driven by a 2 percent increase in metal product prices, a 4.1 percent rise in equipment and machinery rental costs, a 5.1 percent surge in labour costs, and a 3 percent jump in energy prices.
CCI for the non-residential sector increased 2.6 percent YoY.
This increase was attributed to the increase in the costs of renting equipment and machinery, basic materials costs, timber and joinery.
The index reflects price movements in construction input costs across 51 items.

title: Higher labour charges, energy prices drive up Saudi construction costs
